newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela governemnt paid-off bulk of CANTV debt.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela governemnt paid-off bulk of CANTV debt.

text.p: The Venezuelan government has reduced its debts with telephone company CANTV, 40 percent of which is due to be sold in a November global offering, to less than one billion bolivars ($2 million), company President Gustavo Roosen said.
"The government's efforts have been very important," he told a news conference, noting that government debt had been reduced to 980 million bolivars from 21 billion bolivars ($44 million).
"That's a serious reduction, and its helped the company's foreign image."
Roosen added the government repayment would help the company pay down its own $900 million of bank debts "to some $700 million by the end of the year."

Roosen said the government had paid-off debt with the proceeds from a 1991 partial privatisation that saw the government sell 40 percent of the company to the GTE Corp GTE.Nu- led VenWorld Consortium and hand-over another 11 percent to workers.
